[NCBK.7.6] Stream events: `DS_EV_ACTION_CACHE_SET` / `_CACHE_DELETE` fire after
the engine applies the write to its cache (independent of any persistence
callback). `DS_EV_ACTION_CACHE_GET` is **not emitted** — a `cached()` read
is a pure internal read ([LSTO.4.7.1], [RARC.5.7.9]), like a working-memory read,
and does not surface as an action event ([NCBK.2.4]).
